name: Hikari App
description: A calm, restrained theme for a small software product: a washi off-white ground, deep ink-indigo type and two ink bands, pale lavender-grey panels and one desaturated dusk violet kept for small marks, rules and glows, with Sora headings over Inter. Its signature is lantern light: very soft radial glows drawn in CSS, like light through paper, behind the hero, the bento tiles and the ink band. A floating pill navigation sits over every page. The home page is one bento grid of features (a lantern-lit desk photograph, the daily page composed from plain blocks, a focus figure, the Friday review, a customer quote), a week in three moments on an ink band, the plans, the journal and a closing invitation; the footer is a quiet sitemap on ink. With features, pricing (three plans, an editable Most chosen badge, questions), a changelog of dated release entries, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The plans with their prices and the company address, email and support hours are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, figures, prices and step numbers
body text, labels, navigation, forms and buttons
